items.name: Beginner Side Events Ohio 2026
items.information: ### While this competition is beginner-focused and has very lenient time limits, this competition does not include 3x3 and therefore may not be suitable for first-time competitors. Please see [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) for a list of other upcoming competitions in Ohio. This competition also takes place on a **Friday Evening**. Please plan accordingly! Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest as spectator seating will be limited. All competitiors will be expected to help during the group they are not competing in.

items.name: Davis Friday Fall 2026
items.information: ## This competition is on a weekday! (Friday) - All attendees under the age of 18 are required to be accompanied by a parent or guardian. - Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called. - Due to limited seating, we likely won't be able to provide designated seating for guests. Guests are welcome find a seat in the the building's common area. This competition is organized in partnership with West Coast Cubing and Davis Cube Club

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjEyMDUzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fb89206b5263dbd95b0c2c4f82523a97b1aff0d5/home%20wca%20ic%2026.png) # Selamat Datang di Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026! Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026 merupakan kejuaraan nasional speedcubing yang akan diadakan di Lippo Icon Gajah Mada, Jakarta. Kompetisi ini akan diadakan selama tiga hari dan terbuka untuk umum. Setiap peserta diharapkan untuk memerhatikan time limit dan cut-off untuk setiap event karena diatur lebih ketat daripada kompetisi biasanya. Setiap peserta wajib hadir 15 menit sebelum event yang diikuti dimulai. Jika peserta terlambat, maka panitia berhak mendiskualifikasi peserta tersebut. **Pendaftaran on the spot TIDAK AKAN DITERIMA.** **Catatan Penting:** Terdapat batasan limit peserta untuk Event berikut: * 3x3x3 Fewest Moves (terbatas untuk 24 pendaftar pertama) * 4x4x4 Blindfolded (terbatas untuk 10 pendaftar pertama) * 5x5x5 Blindfolded (terbatas untuk 10 pendaftar pertama) * 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (terbatas untuk 20 pendaftar pertama) Akan ada **3 jenis pemenang** dalam kompetisi ini: * **Kategori Indonesia** - 3 pemenang teratas yang mewakili Indonesia di setiap kategori * **Kategori Terbuka** - 3 pemenang teratas kompetisi tanpa memandang kewarganegaraan * **Kategori Anak (Indonesia)** - Top 3 pemenang kompetisi untuk peserta berkewarganegaraan Indonesia berusia di bawah 13 tahun (per 01 November 2026) untuk event 3x3x3 Dengan mendaftar, peserta dan pendamping setuju bahwa penyelenggara, NSA, dan WCA tidak bertanggung jawab atas cedera pribadi atau kerusakan/kehilangan barang selama acara berlangsung. Peserta akan mendapatkan Lanyard dan Name Tag. Pastikan memantau jadwal selama periode pendaftaran terbuka jadwal dapat berubah tergantung jumlah pendaftar tiap event. Silakan melakukan registrasi di laman [daftar](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndonesianChampionship2026/register) dan konfirmasi di form ini: https://forms.gle/Yq4km6UVR2qt2Jnw7. Jika Anda tidak dapat mengakses form tersebut, silakan mengirimkan bukti pembayaran registrasi ke email ini: [nlarchie1@gmail.com](mailto:nlarchie1@gmail.com). Dalam email tersebut, mohon tuliskan nama lengkap, WCA ID (jika Anda memilikinya), tanggal lahir, daftar event yang diikuti, dan bukti pembayaran. ----------------------- # Welcome to Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026! Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026 is the national speedcubing championship that will be held at Lippo Icon Gajah Mada, Jakarta. The competition will take place over three days and is open to the public. All competitors are expected to pay close attention to the time limit and cut-off for each event, as they are set more strictly than in a typical competition. All competitors must arrive 15 minutes before the event starts. If the competitor is late, the competitor will be disqualified. **On the Spot registration WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED.** **Important Notes:** There are competitor limits for the following events: * 3x3x3 Fewest Moves (limited to the first 24 registered competitors) * 4x4x4 Blindfolded (limited to the first 10 registered competitors) * 5x5x5 Blindfolded (limited to the first 10 registered competitors) * 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (limited to the first 20 registered competitors) There will be **3 categories of winners** in this competition: * **Indonesian Category** - The top 3 Indonesian competitors in each event * **Open Category** - The top 3 competitors overall, regardless of nationality * **Kids Category (Indonesia)** - Top 3 winners of the competition among Indonesian citizens under 13 years of age (as of 01 November 2026) in the 3x3x3 event By registering, competitors and their guests acknowledge that the organizers, the NSA, and the WCA are not responsible for any personal injury or any loss of or damage to personal belongings during the event. All competitors will receive a Lanyard and a Name Tag. Please check the competition schedule regularly during the registration period, as it may change depending on the number of registrations for each event. Please register on the [register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndonesianChampionship2026/register) page and confirm your registration by completing this form: https://forms.gle/Yq4km6UVR2qt2Jnw7. If you cannot access the form, please submit your proof of payment for the registration to this email: [nlarchie1@gmail.com](mailto:nlarchie1@gmail.com). In the email, please write your full name, WCA ID (if you have it), date of birth, list of events, and the proof of payment.

items.information: This competition is supported by [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/) as the Texas State Championship for 2026 - We're excited to bring speedcubing back to San Antonio for the 5th annual Texas Championship! While only residents of Texas are eligible for the title of Texas State Champion, all competitors are welcome and encouraged to compete! More information can be found on the [Texas Champion Titles tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TexasChampionship2026#75988-texas-champion-titles). All competitors must read the [Important Information/FAQ tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TexasChampionship2026#75986-important-information-faq) prior to registering. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjE5MDY1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--57bcfd77939cc9fb4ddb721cbc3aba13235c8d44/TXC2026PinkLogo.png) Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TexasChampionship2026#competition-schedule) is tentative - we may adjust the exact starting time of each event based on the final number of registered competitors. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTA5ODQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d90b474725899b23c9c5d15d90dc03063159a03c/southernCubing.png)

items.information: This is the sixth edition of the Viña Cubing Fest and the second edition recognized as the Santa Cruz de la Sierra Regional Championship. All competitors are welcome to participate; however, only residents of Santa Cruz who officially represent our association are eligible for the “Regional Champion” title, awarded to the first-place finisher in each event.To see all the information about register payment go to the next [link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VinaCubingFestVISCZ2026#79980-instrucciones-de-pago) Esta es la sexta edición del Viña Cubing Fest y la segunda edición reconocida como Campeonato Regional de Santa Cruz de la Sierra. Todos los competidores están invitados a participar; sin embargo, únicamente los residentes de Santa Cruz que representen oficialmente a nuestra asociación podrán optar al título de “Campeón Regional”, otorgado al primer lugar de cada categoría. Para ver la informacion acerca del pago de inscripcion entra al siguiente [link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VinaCubingFestVISCZ2026#79980-instrucciones-de-pago) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjE2MTY3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--87890a547fa039ecf6cc80a2fdb88205a116df02/BANNER%20VI%C3%91A%206%20(2).jpg)
